name: get_chunk_context
description: Retrieve a chunk and its surrounding parent/child context window from the same document, ordered by chunk_index. Use this after search when retrieval confidence is medium/low, when contextWindow.recommended is true, or when a relevant snippet needs surrounding section context before citation.

chunk_id.description: The UUID of the chunk to get context for.

context_chunks.description: Number of chunks before and after to include. Default: 2, max: 5.
